citation.authors: Almoraie MM, Spencer JPE, Wagstaff C, Jackson KG
citation.title: Acute Effects of a High-Fat Meal Enriched with Pomegranate Seed Oil on Postprandial Lipemia and Endothelial Function in Postmenopausal Women: a Randomized Controlled Crossover Trial

population.description: Sixteen postmenopausal women (no menstruation for >=1 y, no HRT), UK; enrolment aged <=65 y, BMI 18-35 kg/m2, BP <=140/90, fasting glucose <7.0 mmol/L, no CVD, no lipid/BP medication. Age 59 +/- 1 (SEM) y, range 49-64 (Results text); BMI 24.7 +/- 0.9 (SEM), range 20.7-29.7 (Table 2, mean of both visits; the Results text prints 24.8 +/- 0.9); 9 normal weight, 7 overweight. SDs computed as SEM x sqrt(16): 1 x 4 = 4.0 and 0.9 x 4 = 3.6. Status unselected: glucose tolerance was not screened by a test and 7 of 16 are overweight.

protocols.name: control_visit_fasting
protocols.description: Fasted morning of the control-meal visit: arrival after a 12-h fast (water only), then body composition and cannulation (duration not stated), fasting samples at -30 and 0 min (arm minutes 0 and 30) with 30 min supine rest between; no food. Clock hour not stated; prefast_hours 12 is the fast at arrival, the time from arrival to the -30 min sample is not stated.

protocols.name: control_meal
protocols.description: Control high-fat breakfast at 0 min (toasted white-bread sandwich with jam and a chocolate milk drink with 50 g control oil, palm:rapeseed:safflower 4:0.5:0.5; Table 1: 90.4 g carbohydrate, 52.3 g fat, 21.3 g protein, 4.07 MJ, manufacturers' data; Table 1 also prints sugars 43.9 g and SFAs 22.0, MUFAs 18.8, PUFAs 9.3 under fat), eaten within 20 min; protein from the white bread (100 g) and the drink's skimmed milk (150 g) and skimmed milk powder (15 g), no split printed, so mixed; blood at 0, 30, 60, 90, 120 and hourly to 480 min, nothing but water after. prefast_hours = the 12-h fast at arrival + 0.5 h from the -30 min sample to the meal (time from arrival to the -30 min sample not stated).

meals.food: toasted white-bread sandwich with strawberry jam; warm chocolate milk drink

protocols.name: pso_meal
protocols.description: PSO-rich high-fat breakfast at 0 min, the same breakfast as the control meal with 40 g of the control oil mixture and 10 g pomegranate seed oil in the chocolate milk drink (Table 1: 90.4 g carbohydrate, 52.3 g fat, 21.3 g protein, 4.07 MJ, sugars 43.9 g, SFAs 18.2, MUFAs 15.7, PUFAs 16.3 including 8.3 punicic acid, manufacturers' data), eaten within 20 min; protein from the white bread (100 g) and the drink's skimmed milk (150 g) and skimmed milk powder (15 g), no split printed, so mixed; blood at 0, 30, 60, 90, 120 and hourly to 480 min, nothing but water after. prefast_hours = the 12-h fast at arrival + 0.5 h from the -30 min sample to the meal (time from arrival to the -30 min sample not stated).

meals.fat_source: pomegranate seed oil (10 g) with palm, rapeseed and safflower oil (40 g)
meals.food: toasted white-bread sandwich with strawberry jam; warm chocolate milk drink

Glucose, insulin, NEFA and apoB values at each sampling time: not printed in a table or text, and not even in a figure

Laser Doppler skin perfusion responses to acetylcholine and sodium nitroprusside (Table 4)
Plasma nitrite and nitrate fasting, AUC, iAUC (Table 4; nitrite time course Figure 4)
